body:
The Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences
and the Regional Office for Astronomy Development in the Arab Region

are pleased to invite you to attend the lecture titled:
“Sun Observer – An Introduction to Observation and Exploration”

Presented by Dr. Amr Mohammed,
a space sciences researcher at the National Solar Observatory in the United States.

Date: Saturday, August 24, 2024
Time: 6:00 PM Mecca Time
Venue: Zoom
──────────


We would be delighted to have you with us ❤
